about: The compound's bar, as /en/camp is one camp: the red 20 ft container of compound.json (units id "bar") on its stone plinth, its long hatch open onto the courtyard (east) under a propped flap. The container is on site today (2026-10-25 footage, public/footage/IMG_3195 t6.9 and IMG_3196 t5.9): oxide red, a two-panel hatch already framed into one long wall with a steel ledge under it and a loose pole lying ready to prop it. The 2D (bar-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/bar.html) both read this file. Plan in metres: x along the container to the right as seen from the courtyard (south end left, the cargo doors' north end right), y toward the courtyard (the hatch side), the container's centre at 0,0; heights from the ground. Fit-out past the shell is a design choice, not yet sourced: a farm-stay bar serving coffee, fresh juice and drinks, run by one or two people.

container.about: A 20 ft box, 6,058 x 2,438 x 2,591 mm, painted oxide red, on a fieldstone plinth 300 mm high and 100 mm proud all round (compound.json).

hatch.about: The opening in the courtyard wall: 2.6 m long (compound.json's hatch, 30.1 to 32.7 along the box, here x from the centre), sill 1.05 m and head 2.15 m above the container's base, so the inside work counter meets the sill. The cut-out wall panel is the flap: hinged at the head, swung up and out 115 degrees on two steel struts, a sun and rain shade over the counter.

counter.about: Outside, along the hatch: a Medium Oak timber counter on steel brackets over today's steel ledge, 450 mm deep and 60 mm past the hatch at each end, its top at the sill (1.05 m above the deck: bar height).

deck.about: A timber deck at the plinth's height in front of the hatch, so the counter stands at bar height for the stools. The homepage 3D draws the stools on the ground; this deck is a proposal it can pick up.

stools.about: Five high stools at the counter, 550 mm apart: steel frame, round Medium Oak seat 760 mm above the deck, footrest ring.

inside.about: Lined in off-white painted ply over insulation (the studio's finish), oak plank floor, Medium Oak joinery. A 1.2 m aisle between the work counter under the hatch and the back bar on the far wall; the way in is the cargo doors at the north end.

front.about: The work counter under the hatch, top at the sill, 600 mm deep. Under it, left to right: a store cupboard with the bins, two under-counter fridges (glass doors: juice, milk, soft drinks), the sink with a mixer tap, a drawer stack.

back.about: The back bar on the far (west) wall: a counter 450 mm deep at the same height with the espresso machine and grinder on the left, the juicer and crates of fruit (passion fruit, pineapple, tree tomato) in the middle, a blender on the right; three open Medium Oak shelves above with cups, glasses, jars and plain unbranded bottles; a tall store cupboard at the left end.

store.about: Tall cupboard: beans, cups, glasses, stock.

door.about: The cargo doors at the north end; the right-hand leaf is the way in.
